gaps.quote: the whole network is a linear map on the values, given by a square invertible matrix acting on the stacked banks
gaps.note: The page justifies this from linear gates and invertible frames only. Invertibility of the whole needs every gate to be invertible, which the page does not state, and squareness needs equal numbers of input and output values, which the page does not state.
